A is not well-formed XML: two

have a missing closing quote. B is well-formed; its weaknesses (padded titles, uicontrol 'Author' untranslated) are minor by comparison.

A keeps uicontrol labels consistent and capitalised like the source and translates 'ellipsis' and 'far right'. B lowercases uicontrols ('ajouter un message'), drops the uicontrol on 'Task activity' and omits 'à l'extrême droite'.
Both are accurate with identical markup; A uses the idiomatic 'définir ... sur auto' where B has 'à auto', and its titles are fine nominal forms. A very small edge.
B uses 'point d'extension' where A leaves the anglicism 'extension point' and has the typo 'developpeurs'. B also renders 'file references' faithfully.

A has an uppercase 'OUVREZ', the broken phrase 'correspondant au particulier cadre', and turns uicontrol 'Author' into 'zone de saisie de l'auteur'. B is fluent and keeps the uicontrol and framework term.

B is more complete: it keeps 'edited' (modifiée) and 'même commande de menu', and translates 'pretty print'. A drops 'edited' and leaves 'Pretty Print' in English. B has the typo 'mauvaise alignment', so the margin is small.
A uses 'prend en charge' for 'comes with support', the standard term. B has the calque 'inclut un support pour'. A's 'interface UI' in the index term is redundant, a minor flaw.

B reads more naturally ('intégrer les modifications apportées par les autres utilisateurs', 'éditions, de suppressions ou d'ajouts') and translates the uicontrol 'Working Copy'. A leaves 'Working Copy' in English and has 'en raison de modifications, suppression ou ajout'. B uses a curly apostrophe once, a minor inconsistency.

A translates the title, index terms, keywords and list items ('points d'extension', 'modèle de publication'). B leaves the title, keywords and terms in English and mixes infinitive 'Utiliser' with imperative notes.

A has natural index terms ('Mode de conception d'édition') and 'Occurrences' for 'Mentions'. B has garbled index terms ('Mode de modification de conception', 'Modification de conception de modification') and an indexterm mistranslation.
